input.title: Look up a member's savings balance
input.description: Signs on to the Meridian Core Servicing Console, searches the Member Search panel by Member ID, and reads the member's Savings account current balance from the Member Detail screen. Returns savingsBalance (money), memberName (PII) and memberStatus. Read-only: no records are created, modified or submitted.

parameters.name: memberId
parameters.description: The credit union member number to look up (6 digits).

input.checkpointDescription: The Member Detail screen is displayed for the requested member, with an Accounts table containing a Savings row showing a Current Balance.

expectedOutcomes.textWhenPresent: Not authorized to view this member
expectedOutcomes.probeRationale: Adjacent member records in the demo set may carry a restricted-access flag.
